conventions.canvas: Each character file is 1080 by 1080 (viewBox 0 0 1080 1080), front view, standing, feet resting on y 1012. An adult is about 900 units tall; place characters at scale 0.5 in a 1920 by 1080 scene.
conventions.parts: Top-level groups, bottom to top: leg-l, leg-r, body, arm-l, arm-r, head. Nested: mouth inside head, hand-l inside arm-l, hand-r inside arm-r. Each group's id is its part name. A nested group is a child part of the group that holds it.
conventions.sides: The -l and -r suffixes are the character's own left and right, so in this front view the -l parts are on the viewer's right.
conventions.pivot: Each part group has exactly one direct child marking its joint: a circle r 4 with data-role="pivot" and id "pivot-<part>" (pivot-leg-l, pivot-hand-r, pivot-mouth and so on). XML ids are unique per file, so no element is literally id "pivot": find a part's pivot as its direct child with data-role="pivot", or else the element whose id is "pivot-" plus the part name. The pivot is a marker, not art: drop it from the drawing. Joints: legs at the hip, body at the pelvis centre, arms at the shoulder, hands at the wrist, head at the neck base, mouth at the mouth centre.
conventions.joints: Parts overlap at every joint (rounded caps centred on the pivot, the neck kept in body under the head), so a part rotated about its pivot shows no gap.
conventions.mouths: The mouth chart <id>-mouths.svg is the same size, with the mouths at the same place as the head's mouth group (mouthCenter). It has 8 top-level groups in lip-sync order: Rest, MBP, AI, E, O, U, FV, L-th. Each group's data-name is the shape name exactly as the lip-sync analysis names it (Rest, MBP, AI, E, O, U, FV, L / th); use data-name as the frame name, else the id. The id of the last group is L-th because an id cannot hold spaces or a slash. The mouth group inside head holds the Rest drawing.
conventions.elements: Only path, rect, circle, ellipse, line, polyline and polygon, styled by attributes (fill, stroke, stroke-width, stroke-linecap, stroke-linejoin), solid colors only. No transforms, no defs, no text, no CSS. fill="none" appears on outline-only shapes (glasses, a belt buckle).
conventions.license: Original artwork made for this project and covered by the repository's own license.
